outcome: Construction of the Bolton College of Medical Sciences began in July 2022, with completion expected in 2024. The facility, located at Royal Bolton Hospital, received £20 million from the Levelling Up Fund to train up to 3,000 healthcare students annually.

project_name: The Culture in the City project
Burnley Campus Expansion;  Turf Public Realm Transformation; Railway Station Accessibility Improvements (package)
outcome: Lancashire County Council completed the £3.4m railway station accessibility improvements at Burnley Manchester Road, delivering a new footbridge and lifts to the Preston-bound platform as planned under the Levelling Up Fund package.

The £6.5 million Levelling Up Fund investment in Colne town centre included a £3.5 million regeneration of Colne Market Hall, which opened to the public on 1 May 2026, and improvements to three cultural venues: the Muni Theatre, Pendle Hippodrome, and the Little Theatre.
